thread:
lina-pm: Heads-up: UberEdge SI is blocked on marketplace image replication into GovCloud — validation failing during our partner onboarding. Go-live EOD Friday if we can get this sorted. Need an architecture triage + escalation plan.
jared-se: Can you paste the validation error from the partner?
lina-pm: Partner logs: \"AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::999999999:assumed-role/marketplace-replica is not authorized to perform: ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer on resource\". They also see kms:Decrypt failures after initial pull negotiation.
ravi-eng: Two candidate issues: cross-account ECR permissions + KMS key policy for replicated images. Also verify that the replication used the correct GovCloud replication targets (partition: aws-us-gov).
meilin-sre: I'm checking their network: they say NAT only allows commercial AWS IP ranges. If they're hitting gov endpoints it'll fail. @lina-pm please confirm partner region/partition.
lina-pm: Confirmed partner is targeting us in us-gov-west-1. They assumed marketplace role arn:aws-us-gov:iam::888888888:role/uberedge-marketplace-replica (partner sent an ARN in gov partition).
aisha-sec: KMS note: GovCloud keys are separate; the key policy must explicitly allow the external principal to decrypt. Any temporary change must be logged and approved. I'll standby for an emergency exception if needed.
karim-field: From partner side, CI creates ephemeral creds via marketplace token exchange. If the marketplace replication role can't read layers because of missing ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer, the validation will error out.
jared-se: Quick repro plan: assume their replica role in our staging gov account and attempt docker pull. Who can give me a role session name + assume role URL?
lina-pm: Partner provided role ARN and a short-lived token; DM'd it to you.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled job 'uberedge-replicate-staging' at 16:20 UTC -> https://deploy.redwood.dev/jobs/uberedge-replicate-staging
meilin-sre: Running the staging pull now. Update: pull failed with AccessDenied for GetDownloadUrlForLayer. After temporarily granting that permission to the replica role, pull advanced then failed at KMS Decrypt: \"AccessDeniedException: not authorized to decrypt with key\". Logs: https://s3.redwood.internal/uberedge/logs/replicate-staging-3167010000.log
ravi-eng: Ok KMS is the blocker. Two paths: 1) add the partner role as a principal in the key policy with kms:Decrypt for that key (temporary), or 2) change replication to use a copy with re-encryption under our GovCloud key and grant the partner pull-only rights (longer).
aisha-sec: I can fast-track a scoped key-policy exception limited to the single key + timebox (4 hours), but org-owner signoff required. I'll join the emergency call in 20 minutes. We will require an audit event + auto-revert.
karim-field: Partner prefers option 1 for speed. They're on standby to validate immediately.
jared-se: If we do option 1, let's also tighten IAM on the replica role to only allow ecr:BatchGetImage and ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer scoped to the specific repo ARN to reduce blast radius. Sample snippet I used in staging: ```json
{
  \"Effect\":\"Allow\",
  \"Action\":[\"ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer\",\"ecr:BatchGetImage\"],
  \"Resource\":\"arn:aws-us-gov:ecr:us-gov-west-1:111111111:repository/marketplace/uberedge/*\"
}
```
meilin-sre: Agreed. Also confirm partner CI hits the gov endpoint: `https://api.ecr.us-gov-west-1.amazonaws.com`. Partner had earlier been using the commercial endpoint in CI template.
lina-pm: Partner updated CI to gov endpoints just now and accepted a calendar invite for the 16:30 triage call.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: replication job completed in staging with temporary key exception -> status: success. Details: https://deploy.redwood.dev/jobs/uberedge-replicate-staging/3167010050
partner-bot: partner-bot: automated validation webhook: marketplace validation passed in staging at 16:35 UTC.
aisha-sec: Security follow-up: opening ticket PROD-4329 to 1) revert temporary key entry after verification, 2) add alerting for cross-account Decrypt events, 3) document marketplace replication checklist for GovCloud.
ravi-eng: Post-go-live plan: switch to re-encrypt-on-replication approach (we'll manage key ownership in GovCloud) and update docs. That requires an infra rollout but removes cross-account keys long-term.
karim-field: Partner confirmed they can proceed with go-live if we revert key change within 24 hours and send a short attestation once reverted.
lina-pm: Great — immediate next steps: a) apply scoped ecr permissions + temporary KMS exception (aisha-sec will approve), b) run staging replicate (done), c) run prod canary tonight (jared-se + meilin-sre), d) revert key policy and confirm (aisha-sec). Call notes and checklist saved in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.internal/uberedge/onboarding. I'll DM partner the status.
jared-se: I'll own the prod canary and rollback playbook.
aisha-sec: Signed off on timeboxed exception. Will create monitoring and auto-revert job.
lina-pm: Closing loop: partner ran final validation in staging successfully. If prod canary passes tonight we keep Friday go-live. Will update this thread after the canary. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
